item: G2-13 (W12 D3): credit-modal heritage module rate segment invisible
correction: [id*=u-credit] .heritage-rating-module .page-rate-widget-box{background-color:transparent;color:rgb(var(--swatch-text-secondary-color))} appended to the existing Q1-7 heritage block
frame: W13 probe frame on the W10 campaign runtime (S9 framerail :3410, fixture credit-heritage page, credit modal opened via .creditButton)
finding: Step 0 (receipt g213) showed the Q1-7 block darkens the module shell but the nested .page-rate-widget-box keeps its own light ground rgb(252,252,252) while its text follows the on-dark color, so the rate segment stayed white-on-white. With the widget rule the widget ground is transparent over the dark pill and every segment (emblem, rate points, buttons) reads light-on-dark; screenshot shots-g213fix/creditHeritage-1440-with.png verified visually. The page-level heritage module is outside the [id*=u-credit] scope and unchanged.
